name: stem
description: Sign-in for shiftbloom studio apps: passkeys, email codes, organizations and OpenID Connect on Cloudflare Workers

scripts.dev: npm run build:client && node scripts/render-config.mjs --example && wrangler dev -c wrangler.local.jsonc
scripts.build: npm run build:client && node scripts/render-config.mjs --example && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.local.jsonc --dry-run --outdir=.wrangler/dry-run
scripts.deploy: npm run build:client && node scripts/render-config.mjs && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.deploy.jsonc
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && vitest run && npm run build
scripts.db:migrate: node scripts/render-config.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply stem-db --remote -c wrangler.deploy.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:local: node scripts/render-config.mjs --example && wrangler d1 migrations apply stem-db --local -c wrangler.local.jsonc
